title.rendered: GTA SA Lite Indonesia Apk Data Download

content.rendered:
Download GTA SA Lite Apk Data for android which works for all GPU and is very to install.

Indonesia version of GTA SA Lite was Modded by ilham52 from the original GTA San Andreas available on Google Play Store in which he added so many features to the game which features some Indonesian characters and items such as Moto Bikes and Vehicles.

Main Features Of GTA SA Lite Indonesia

Below are the mains features of the Indonesian version of GTA SA Lite for Android:

  • Borobudur Temple added.
  • Monas
  • BSOR
  • GTA extreme road
  • Gelora Bung Karno
  • Funny Adverts Board
  • Full Indonesian language support
  • Trees beside houses
  • Indonesian city names added.
  • Alexis Hotels
  • Indonesian currency
  • over 15 vehicles added.
  • Rust Car
  • Angkot
  • Bajaj
  • Blue Bird Taxi
  • PLN Car
  • Ice cream car
  • Fishing Boat car.

Download GTA SA Lite Indonesia Apk + Data

Download GTA SA Lite Apk and Data for three GPUs such as Mali, PowerVR, Andreno, remember to download supported GPU of your device, audio file also included and the original file size is 700 MB after extraction.

How To Install GTA SA Lite Indonesia

Follow the simple steps below to install GTA SA lite Indonesian version below:

  1. Install GTA SA Apk
  2. Download Zarchiver Apk to extract GTA SA lite data.
  3. Extract the game data into Android/Data – which means go to Android folder,  inside click data folder and extract.
  4. finally you can go to app menu and start playing your game, you can also watch the installation video below.
